name: hub-merged
description: Cloudflare Pages Functions backend for the merged INR/PKR/PHP Issue Hub. This file exists so `npm install` pulls in @cf-wasm/photon before Cloudflare Pages bundles functions/ -- Build command must be set to "npm install" in the Pages dashboard (Settings -> Builds and deployments), see wrangler.toml's comment and README-MERGE.md for why this can't be set via wrangler.toml itself.
